tools_helpful.evidence: Scaffolded the WinUI 3 project and did the bulk Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite in one pass (mig turn ~2); DispatcherTimer and NotifyUser helper then compiled unchanged.

Section 7 smoke launch caught a clean-build/crash-at-startup (native code 0xC000027B) that neither the build nor the analyzer saw (mig turn ~70); also gated on MIGRATION-MAPPING.md rows still marked 'copied'.
Captured the native exception code (0xC000027B) and faulting module (Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll) from WER, which was the only signal that the app crashed at launch (mig turns ~70-73).
Surfaced the startup-crash pattern text the agent used to reason about the init-order race (mig turn ~72).

tool_limitations.limitation: The 0xC000027B hint only says 'legacy projection/activation incompatibility -> defer the API', but in this trial 0xC000027B was actually the static-window init-order navigation race (same root cause as E_POINTER). The guidance steered toward deferral rather than the navigate-after-Activate fix.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add the init-order race (deferred first navigation) as a cause for 0xC000027B and cross-link to #windowing, alongside the unsupported-API-defer cause.

special_apis.special_handling: The project's root namespace (derived from the sample folder name 'Inclinometer') collides with the sensor type name, so a bare `Inclinometer` field resolves to the namespace and yields CS0118. Fully qualify as Windows.Devices.Sensors.Inclinometer.
No static Window.Current in WinUI 3 desktop; rewired to the tracked App.MainWindow instance. Covered by PATTERNS.md#windowing (WUI0002).

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'Inclinometer' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario1_DataEvents.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Assembly/root namespace equals a WinRT type used bare in code; the namespace shadows the type.
errors_encountered.fix: Fully qualify the field/variable type as Windows.Devices.Sensors.Inclinometer (mig turn ~57).

errors_encountered.error: CS0122: 'MainWindow.RootFrame' is inaccessible due to its protection level (App.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent attempted to drive first navigation from App.OnLaunched via window.RootFrame, but RootFrame is private to MainWindow.
errors_encountered.fix: Moved first navigation inside MainWindow (Activated handler), matching the documented pattern (mig turns ~77-79).

errors_encountered.error: Startup crash, native code 0xC000027B (stowed exception), faulting module Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll
errors_encountered.root_cause: MainWindow navigated to a Page whose OnNavigatedTo read App.MainWindow before OnLaunched assigned the static -> init-order race.
errors_encountered.fix: Deferred first RootFrame.Navigate to the MainWindow.Activated event with a _navigated guard (mig turns ~70-80).

errors_encountered.root_cause: Asset lives under SharedContent\media\Samples\, not SharedContent\media\.

errors_encountered.error: Validate-UwpMigration FAIL: 10 MIGRATION-MAPPING.md rows still Status=copied
errors_encountered.root_cause: Rows left at 'copied' instead of being flipped to done/deferred after adaptation.
errors_encountered.fix: Flipped all rows to done (mig turn ~69).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App built clean but crashed at launch (0xC000027B); first fix attempt (navigate from App.OnLaunched) then failed to compile (CS0122).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: First navigation happened before the static window reference was assigned, and the corrective attempt reached into MainWindow's private RootFrame from App.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Deferred first navigation to MainWindow.Activated with a guard flag.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: The 0xC000027B startup-crash guidance pointing at the init-order race + navigate-after-Activate recipe (currently it only mentions 'defer the unsupported API'), so the agent lands on the documented #windowing fix on the first attempt.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Project namespace equals the WinRT sensor type name.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A build-errors entry for CS0118 telling the agent to fully qualify a Windows type whose name collides with the project namespace (the sample-folder-name == WinRT-type-name case).

env_issues.issue: No inclinometer sensor and no accessible UWP UIA on the bench machine; both apps show 'No inclinometer found' and the UWP baseline could not be actuated.
env_issues.workaround: Scoring relied on WinUI UIA trees + structural parity; measurement-tool artifact, not a migration defect.
